# hello-world

> A site built with gopage: pages render on the server from a plan compiled at build time, and a
> client component takes over only where the template marks one.

Every page here is server-rendered HTML. There is no client-side router to wait for and no
hydration step for the page as a whole, so the markup you receive is the markup that was meant.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what gopage is, the source of a component, and a live server-sent event stream

## Data

- [/api/health](/api/health): a JSON health check, answered by Go on both deploy targets
- [/api/stories](/api/stories): a `text/event-stream` of Hacker News items, five at most

## Conventions

- [/sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml): every route, with `hreflang` alternates when the site has more
  than one language
- [/robots.txt](/robots.txt): crawl rules and a pointer to the sitemap
